test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

She answered (1)/ very brief during the interview (2)/ so that the panel (3)/ could proceed quickly. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "very brief" in part 2 of the sentence.
 
• The word "brief" is an adjective, and to describe the manner of answering, the adverb "briefly" should be used.
 
• Thus, "She answered very brief" is incorrect and should be replaced with "She answered very briefly."
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She answered very briefly during the interview so that the panel could proceed quickly."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "She answered"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "so that the panel"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "could proceed quickly"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
